findings.message: False cross-reference to Unit 2 Nawabshah content (sources). Resolved in commit 3782e123: topic-01.mdx:107-115 replaced the invalid Unit 2 cross-reference with an independent two-Sindh-schools example illustrating hygiene factors, aligned with content-spec.md:813-814.
Misquote of OpenStax source (sources). Resolved in commit 3782e123: topic-01.mdx:76-77 corrected reaching one full potential to achieving one full potential.
Pronoun altered inside quotation marks (sources). Resolved in commit 3782e123: topic-01.mdx:53 corrected it brings to they bring.

Deficit/growth gloss goes beyond cited source (sources). topic-01.mdx:77-80 glosses deficit needs as the lower four and growth needs as the top under a Seifert & Sutton (2009) citation; Seifert Table 8 uses a six-need scheme. The five-level mapping reflects standard textbook Maslow rather than Seifert specific table. Carried from run001.

Teacher-notes practical-work overstatement (authority). Resolved in commit 3782e123: unit-teacher-notes.mdx:83-87 rephrased to clarify that the recording task is the unit instantiation of the course-generic practical work menu.
Unsupported coverage reinforcement row (coverage). coverage/unit-06.md:24 maps U6-6 to topic-02.mdx The attribution loop, which discusses attributions rather than emotions. Carried from run001.

Spec key terms not taught (coverage). content-spec.md:763-766 lists Stress, Self-Esteem and Self-Concept as Unit 6 key terms, and teacher notes mention stress in Urdu list (unit-teacher-notes.mdx:76-77), though the unit prose focuses on motivation and emotion. Carried from run001.

Dangling word-count reference in ERQ rubrics (assessment). unit-assessment.mdx ERQ rubrics include within the word count while the question stem does not specify an explicit word count. Carried from run001.

Integrative ERQ narrower than approved blueprint (assessment). content-spec.md:846-849 describes an integrative ERQ covering three theories and attribution loop, while ERQ 5 stem focuses on SDT three needs and emotions. Carried from run001.

MCQ key clustering (assessment). 9 of 10 MCQ keys are option b (unit-assessment.mdx:155-168). All items and keys are verified correct, but position spread is skewed toward option b. Carried from run001.

Herzberg sourcing declaration pattern (sources). sources/unit-06.md:27-31 declares U6-3 under No-external-source rows rather than Unverifiable sources. Standard textbook description disclosed in prose. Carried from run001.

Bound-excerpt coverage gap (sources). spielman2020.md header was updated in commit 3782e123 to list section 10.1; the 10.1 excerpt itself does not include the Yerkes-Dodson arousal text, though verified live on OpenStax 2e. Carried from run001.

Manifest drift in run001 (process). Resolved: fresh manifest prepared and validated against current repository index.
